findings.label: Brief deviation on pbxproj wiring
findings.detail: The prescribed PBXFileReference/PBXBuildFile/Resources-phase edits with new object IDs were intentionally skipped in favor of only adding ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME = AppIcon to the app target's Debug (A1000018) and Release (A1000019) configs. This is correct for an objectVersion 77 synchronized-folder project (StandUp is a PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup); explicit references would double-register the catalog and cause a duplicate-output build failure. Build evidence (BUILD SUCCEEDED, AppIcon.icns + Assets.car, CFBundleIconName/CFBundleIconFile = AppIcon) confirms the catalog compiles and embeds. No action needed.

findings.label: Unrelated files in the commit
findings.detail: README.md and docs/images/screenshot.png are bundled into the same commit (04734c1) as the icon change. Not blocking; note only if commit hygiene matters.
